Vulnerabilities.Title: requests: unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization header
Vulnerabilities.Description: Requests is a HTTP library. Since Requests 2.3.0, Requests has been leaking Proxy-Authorization headers to destination servers when redirected to an HTTPS endpoint.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Werkzeug: high resource consumption when parsing multipart forms
Vulnerabilities.Description: Werkzeug is a comprehensive WSGI web application library. Werkzeug prior to 2.2.3 can parse multipart form data with an unbounded number of fields.

Vulnerabilities.Title: pip: arbitrary code execution via package URL
Vulnerabilities.Description: An issue was discovered in Pip before 19.2. Arbitrary option injection allows for arbitrary code execution in pip.

Vulnerabilities.Title: PyYAML: arbitrary code execution via untrusted YAML
Vulnerabilities.Description: A vulnerability was discovered in the PyYAML library in versions before 5.3.1, where it is susceptible to arbitrary code execution when it processes untrusted YAML files.

Vulnerabilities.Title: urllib3: ReDoS in the authority component of a URL
Vulnerabilities.Description: An issue was discovered in urllib3 before 1.26.5. When provided with a URL containing many @ characters, the regex can run for a very long time.
